note: Recorded on 22-23 Nov 2026. The four small programs ran offline in a fake sandbox (a real node process, no network). The 60-program table ran on real E2B.

thrown-error.why: The caller needs the real error to decide what to do next. With the patch this matches the VM.

printed-markers.why: Printed text shaped like the result markers can replace the return value. This is a separate bridge behavior, outside the scope of this patch.

bigint-date.code: return await test.inspect({ big: 10n, at: new Date(0) });
bigint-date.why: Values with no JSON form cannot cross the bridge. The patch makes the error say why instead of exit status 1. Full parity with the VM is outside its scope.
bigint-date.fix: error: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt

never-answers.why: A tool call that never answers. The VM does not apply its timeout to an awaited call (upstream issue #2874), so it does not return in 4 s. E2B ends the run.
